title: Frame gateway outbound mesh traffic with signed link-layer wire format
description: rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs upstream_to_mesh and mesh_to_mesh return bare [L2_DISPATCH_SCHC || SCHC] payloads. lichend queues these bytes directly to sim/serial/HAT transmit paths, while the receiving production RplStack expects a complete LichenFrame and authenticates it before SCHC. Thus TUN-to-mesh and forwarded mesh traffic are not interoperable and are rejected as malformed/unsigned. Route outbound IPv6 through the owned Stack/RplStack link TX path and return/drain complete signed wire frames; add an end-to-end two-stack acceptance test.
